author: Insta360
description:
Your old dive footage could help protect sharks 🦈

The @padiaware Shark & Ray Discovery Challenge invites you to identify 30 shark and ray species through confirmed sightings in the PADI Global Shark & Ray Census. And yes—past dives count.

With one in three shark and ray species under threat, there's never been a more important time to get involved. Join the movement at https://pros-blog.padi.com/introducing-the-global-shark-ray-census-padi-awares-newest-citizen-science-program/.

Huge thanks to @abc4explore !
